title: guamod
description: 这是一个minecraft1.21.1模组，它加入了新的武器新的方块和新的生物，它是基于neoforge开发的,内容来源于作者班内热梗This is a mod for Minecraft 1.21.1. It adds new weapons, new blocks, and new mobs. It is developed based on NeoForge, and its content comes from popular memes within the author’s class.
body:
This mod, developed for **Minecraft 1.21.1** using the **NeoForge** modding framework, brings a unique blend of humor and creativity to the game. It introduces a variety of new content—including **weapons, blocks, and mobs**—all inspired by the most memorable and beloved memes that have emerged within the author’s own classroom community. Every item and creature tells a story, turning inside jokes into tangible gameplay elements.

Among the additions, players can craft the **Zuangua Sword**, a powerful weapon forged from custom materials and featuring a distinctive attack sound that reflects its humorous origin. A growing collection of **special blocks** adds both decorative and functional possibilities, while new **mobs** with quirky behaviors bring unexpected encounters to the overworld. The mod also includes custom **advancements** and **recipes**, encouraging exploration and rewarding players who dive into its lighthearted lore.

Built on NeoForge 21.1.215+, the mod follows best practices for modern Minecraft modding, ensuring compatibility and stability. It is designed for both survival and creative play, appealing to anyone who enjoys community-driven content with a personal touch. The mod is actively maintained, with plans to expand the meme-based arsenal and introduce more interactive features based on feedback.

Whether you are a fan of custom swords, nostalgic classroom memories, or simply looking for a fresh twist on vanilla Minecraft, this mod offers a playful experience that celebrates creativity and shared laughter. All resources are open for exploration, and the project welcomes contributions from the community.
